scope: Original8R local Hausdorff dimension propagation plus actual nonempty open-image bilipschitz distance charts yield ONE integer m<=n for the original closed ball and every nonempty ambient-open subset of its half-ball, for ALL natural n including zero.
source_conventions: Parameter1 is the curvature lower bound -1. Local compactness of the OPEN8R ball is derived from finite dimension in the final consumer; no open-ball completeness is asserted. The actual centered chart is an onto homeomorphism with two-sided metric bounds, not an isometry. No continuity or compactness of a chosen radial image is inferred.
